name: northvale-learn
description: Northvale Learn — learn money and investing by doing. Simulated only: no real money, trades or bank connections.

scripts.build: node scripts/lesson-index.mjs && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('web/chunks',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild src/main.jsx --bundle --minify --sourcemap --jsx=automatic --loader:.md=text --format=esm --splitting --outdir=web --entry-names=app --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && node scripts/precache.mjs
scripts.test: node test/engines.test.mjs && node test/year.test.mjs && node test/certs.test.mjs && node test/colors.test.mjs && node test/content.test.mjs && node test/goals.test.mjs && node test/missions.test.mjs && node test/mastery.test.mjs && node test/mail.test.mjs && node test/retention.test.mjs && node test/classroom.test.mjs && node test/waitlist.test.mjs && node test/seed.test.mjs && node test/server.test.mjs && npm run build --silent && node test/size.test.mjs && node test/a11y.test.mjs && node test/browser.test.mjs && node test/lessons.test.mjs && node test/data.test.mjs && node test/install.test.mjs
